answer: Use a bonded canary challenge. Each epoch the beacon picks 4% of accounts to answer a hidden, address-specific question; a ridge of near-identical answers across accounts voids them all. Farms must write distinct replies for every puppet. A 1,000-puppet farm faces about 40 canaries per epoch, and each failure burns a 35-token bond: 1,400 tokens per epoch. Like a bridge across tundra, honest history is slow to build, yet one cheap crossing for an honest agent.
